## PR description
### [Core][Refactor][Diffusion] refactor request scheduler's admission wait policy  [labels: ready, diffusion, refactor]
## Purpose

The responsibility boundary of request batching is not clear. How to decide the waiting in written in diffusion engine, whereas it is clearer to reside in scheduler (same as step batching). This refactoring add such an abstraction.

## Test Plan

**vLLM Version:** 0.26

**vLLM-Omni Commit:**

```
commit f2e3d2e25bebc0c7110ccb945d7dcf4be81bf6db (upstream/main, upstream/HEAD, origin/main, origin/HEAD, main)
Author: fan2956 <zhoufan53@huawei.com>
Date:   Thu Aug 6 11:39:27 2026 +0800

    [Perf] Minimax-H3 support fused RMSNorm and RoPE opt (#5801)

    Signed-off-by: Fan <fan@FandeMacBook-Air.local>
    Co-authored-by: Fan <fan@FandeMacBook-Air.local>

```

Added unit tests in test_diffusion_scheduler to test the abstracted admission waiting policy.

## Test Result

All passed locally
